card.name: Words just before cautionary warnings
card.fires_on: Linking words and word parts inside warning passages, right before text that cautions the reader, such as 'and' after 'adequate precautions', 'Overest' + 'imating', or 'whether' after 'assess'. Also a digit in a phone number.

modes.label: List joiner in dose-safety lines
modes.description: The 'and' or comma before 'readiness for emergencies' in a list of proper dosage, technique and precautions.
modes.example: depends on proper dosage, correct technique, adequate precautions<< and>> readiness for emergencies.

modes.label: Overestimating the dose
modes.description: The ending of 'Overest' as it becomes 'overestimating' in warnings about converting doses.
modes.example: Overest<<imating>> the dose of BELBUCA when converting

modes.label: Whether in warning clauses
modes.description: The word 'whether' introducing a judgment in a warning sentence.
modes.example: sufficient experience to assess<< whether>> Gabapentin impairs their ability to
